title: Conductive Lattice: 5,500 cr once; accept at Node Beta, 20 silver ore bought at Ironlight Crossroads (LHS 1140), delivered at Node Beta
note: Flown once by hand 2026-11-15 23:33 to 23:55 UTC by one trader, hold empty on the way out: the accept hands out no silver (the mission text: source it from Solarian mining systems); 20 silver ore bought at Ironlight Crossroads for 3,040 cr (152 cr each, no sales tax there; 200 units stood at that price in the census book of 23:21 UTC, 180 after our buy, more levels not seen); handed in at the Node Beta redock: +5,500 cr; RESULT 3/3 stops in 21 min, credits +2,312 (one-time 2,460, fuel 148). Once per pilot: the Node Beta board did not list it again after the hand-in and offered Resonance Substrate (7,000 cr, 15 energy crystal) instead. max_pilots 9: the silver that stood at 152 cr carries nine more deliveries; whether that ask refills is not known. Beyond policed space (orders F13): requires.empty_hold. Pays 45 trading XP. 2026-11-16 00:02 UTC: stop 1 also stores voidborn_neural_soma (Precedence hands out one), so nothing of value leaves policed space (orders F13); the dispatcher lets up to five units of goods pass its empty-hold check.
